prerequisites: Admission to the Master's in Telecommunication Engineering studies.

The Master's Thesis can only be evaluated once it is confirmed that the student has passed the evaluations foreseen in the remaining subjects of the Study Plan and therefore has all the necessary credits for obtaining the Master's degree, except those corresponding to the Thesis itself.
syllabus_topics: Master's Thesis content framed within themes of telecommunication engineering, to be specified based on the individual thesis topic.

assessment_methods.method: General presentation: adherence to standards, legibility, writing, spelling, etc.
Logical and coherent structure in the representation of information, ideas, and arguments.
Interest of the author's viewpoints, judgments, and conclusions.
Quality of the presentation: appropriate use of media, correctness of oral expression, logical structuring, adherence to available time, etc.
Ability to engage and capture the audience's attention.
Ability to respond to questions raised by tribunal members.

assessment_rules: Evaluation will be based on the completion, presentation, and defense of an original, individually prepared project before a university tribunal, once all study plan credits have been obtained. This project will be a comprehensive telecommunication engineering project of a professional nature, synthesizing the competencies acquired in the program. A tribunal of professors will assess various aspects including presentation, logical structure, scientific-technical quality, and responsiveness during defense. Specific details of the evaluation are subject to the general regulations of the University of Oviedo and the Gijón Polytechnic School of Engineering.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (Telecomunicación, Gijón)
degree: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación
